name: version-tag-mixed-namespace-filtered
description: The repo carries prerelease and non-release tags that -v:refname ranks ABOVE the real latest release (v6.7.0-rc1, skill-v9.9.9, docs-2026-08-01). The tag leg must consider only vX.Y.Z / X.Y.Z tags, so it selects v6.6.1 and the shipped files are never compared against a release candidate or a vendored tag namespace.
